name: Geode Predictive Input Buffer
description: Orb Assist compares the normal Assisted Click route with the earliest safe orb-contact tick. It stops candidate search at the first complete safe path, then revalidates exact native contact and the post-orb trajectory from the current player state before firing. Unknown motion is checked live; confirmed moving orbs and incomplete simulations fail closed.

stage.name: Prediction Stage
stage.description: F6 cycles Stage 1 (2/2 base ticks), Stage 2 (4/4), Stage 3 (8/8), Stage 4 (16/8), and Off. Values are All / Wave.

console-key.name: Console Toggle Key
console-key.description: Closes or reopens the live command-prompt console on Windows.

auto-scan.name: Automatic Level Scan
auto-scan.description: Automatically scan a compatible level the first time it is paused. Scanning runs in small CPU slices and requires the level to stay paused.

route-snap.name: Use Scanned Route (Experimental)
route-snap.description: Let early inputs match the route found by automatic scanning. Off by default because a scan can be imperfect on portal-heavy or otherwise unsupported levels.

orb-helper.name: Assist Orb Clicks
orb-helper.description: Compare normal Assisted Click with an exact Orb Delay simulation near a supported stationary orb. Delay only when the post-orb route is safer, then confirm exact live contact before firing. Unsupported/moving orbs and incomplete simulations are rejected.
